description: This file defines session management functions for a KeystoneJS project, including stateless and stored session strategies, utilizing cookies, Iron for encryption, and crypto for generating secrets.

methods.name: statelessSessions
methods.description: Creates a stateless session strategy using cookies and Iron encryption, with configurable options.

methods.name: storedSessions
methods.description: Creates a stored session strategy that combines a session store with stateless cookie-based sessions.
